_about: Per viewpoint and bearing (every 0.5 deg from north, clockwise), the skyline angle (degrees above level) of the visible ground in each distance band, None where none of that band shows. Built by tools/course/goodwood/horizon.py from the AWS Terrain Tiles.

stands.what: the top of the March Stand, looking out over the course (the TV gantry's height)

post.what: the winning post, a camera on the rail

loop-top.what: the top of the loop, a tracking camera

east-end.what: the far end of the straight (the 6f start)
